instruction: How to list users in a group
output: openstack group show my-group

instruction: How to add user to group
output: openstack group add user my-group my-user

instruction: How to remove user from group
output: openstack group remove user my-group my-user

instruction: How to assign role to group
output: openstack role add --group my-group --project my-project admin

instruction: How to create an application credential
output: openstack application credential create --description 'my app cred' my-cred

instruction: How to list application credentials
output: openstack application credential list

instruction: How to delete application credentials
output: openstack application credential delete CRED_ID

instruction: How to limit server to a specific host
output: openstack server create --availability-zone nova:host01 --image debian-12 --flavor m1.small my-instance

instruction: How to set server quotas
output: openstack quota set --instances 5 --cores 10 --ram 8192 my-project

instruction: How to show project quotas
output: openstack quota show my-project

instruction: How to list server diagnostics
output: openstack server diagnose my-instance

instruction: How to create server with user-data
output: openstack server create --user-data cloud-init.yaml --image debian-12 --flavor m1.small my-instance

instruction: How to create server with config drive
output: openstack server create --config-drive true --image debian-12 --flavor m1.small my-instance

instruction: How to create server on specific network
output: openstack server create --network my-network --image debian-12 --flavor m1.small my-instance

instruction: How to boot from volume
output: openstack server create --volume my-boot-volume --flavor m1.small my-instance

instruction: How to create a server with block device mapping
output: openstack server create --block-device-mapping vdb=my-volume --flavor m1.small --image debian-12 my-instance

instruction: How to add server to a security group
output: openstack server add security group my-instance web-sg

instruction: How to remove server from security group
output: openstack server remove security group my-instance web-sg

instruction: How to set auto-delete for a volume
output: openstack server set --auto-delete my-instance

instruction: How to list network agents
output: openstack network agent list

instruction: How to show network agent details
output: openstack network agent show AGENT_ID

instruction: How to list network qos policies
output: openstack network qos policy list

instruction: How to create network qos policy
output: openstack network qos policy create my-policy

instruction: How to set qos bandwidth limit rule
output: openstack network qos rule create --type bandwidth-limit --max-kbps 10240 --max-burst-kbits 1024 my-policy

instruction: How to apply qos policy to port
output: openstack port set --qos-policy my-policy my-port
